description.en: Applies a numbered skill-effect state to a match member, looked up by team slot and character ID, with an optional extra parameter.
Index of the team/side the character belongs to.
Character ID string identifying which member to affect.
Optional extra parameter for the effect (defaults to -1 if omitted).
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Apply skill effect 39 to a match member
CMND_BTL_SET_SKILL_EFFECT(0, "para_cp0008", 39);
